title: What the scheduling service does with each answer
heading: A Limit Without a Plan Means "Unknown", Never "Infeasible"
cases: an optimal plan is published, a proven infeasibility goes to the conflict finder, and unboundedness is a model bug
a hedged answer is settled first, never sent to the conflict finder
a limit with no plan claims nothing about the model
a plan stopped by a limit is published only when its gap is small enough
in a minimization the bound lies below the plan, so the gap is a size
a plan worth 0 has no relative gap, so only an equal bound proves it
a reason the table does not name goes to a person
